# Crossplane XRD + Composition for Versioned Bucket Infrastructure

Below is a production-ready implementation using Crossplane Composition Functions (function-patch-and-transform mode) for the Spine scenario, with dev/prod environment support.

## Prerequisites

- Crossplane v1.13+ (Composition Functions support)
- `provider-aws` (Upbound) installed
- `function-patch-and-transform` (crossplane-contrib) installed

```bash
# Install composition function
kubectl apply -f https://marketplace.upbound.io/xpls/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform/latest/install.yaml
```

---

## 1. Composite Resource Definition (XRD)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: versionedbuckets.acme.crossplane.io
spec:
  group: acme.crossplane.io
  names:
    kind: VersionedBucket
    plural: versionedbuckets
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedBucketClaim
    plural: versionedbucketclaims
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              parameters:
                type: object
                properties:
                  # Environment identifier
                  environment:
                    type: string
                    enum: ["dev", "prod"]
                    description: "Deployment environment"
                  
                  # AWS region configuration
                  region:
                    type: string
                    default: "us-east-1"
                    description: "Primary AWS region"
                  replicationRegion:
                    type: string
                    default: "us-west-2"
                    description: "Target region for prod cross-region replication"
                  
                  # S3 configuration
                  bucketName:
                    type: string
                    description: "S3 bucket name (must be globally unique)"
                    minLength: 3
                    maxLength: 63
                  
                  # RDS configuration
                  dbInstanceClass:
                    type: string
                    description: "DB instance type (e.g., db.t3.micro, db.t3.medium)"
                  dbAllocatedStorage:
                    type: integer
                    default: 20
                    description: "Allocated storage in GiB"
                  dbBackupRetention:
                    type: integer
                    default: 7
                    minimum: 1
                    maximum: 35
                    description: "Backup retention in days"
                  
                  # IAM configuration
                  serviceAccountName:
                    type: string
                    description: "Service account identifier for IAM role"
                  enableOIDC:
                    type: boolean
                    default: false
                    description: "Enable OIDC trust (prod only)"
                  
                required:
                - environment
                - bucketName
                - dbInstanceClass
                - serviceAccountName
              resourceRefs:
                description: "References to created resources"
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    apiVersion:
                      type: string
                    kind:
                      type: string
                    name:
                      type: string
          status:
            type: object
            properties:
              bucketName:
                type: string
              bucketArn:
                type: string
              rdsEndpoint:
                type: string
              iamRoleArn:
                type: string
```

---

## 2. Composition (Function-Patch-and-Transform Mode)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versionedbucket-aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: acme.crossplane.io/v1
    kind: VersionedBucket
  mode: Functions
  functions:
  - name: patch-and-transform
    type: Container
    config:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      resources:

      # ============================================================
      # S3 BUCKET
      # ============================================================
      - name: s3-bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          metadata:
            name: s3-bucket
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              # Disable public ACLs
              acl: private
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: LowerCase
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket

      # ============================================================
      # S3 BUCKET VERSIONING (All environments)
      # ============================================================
      - name: s3-versioning
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketVersioning
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucketRef:
                name: s3-bucket
              versioningConfiguration:
              - status: Enabled
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider

      # ============================================================
      # S3 BUCKET ENCRYPTION (AES-256)
      # ============================================================
      - name: s3-encryption
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucketRef:
                name: s3-bucket
              rule:
              - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                - sseAlgorithm: AES256
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider

      # ============================================================
      # S3 BUCKET PUBLIC ACCESS BLOCK
      # ============================================================
      - name: s3-public-access-block
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucketRef:
                name: s3-bucket
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider

      # ============================================================
      # S3 CROSS-REGION REPLICATION (PROD ONLY)
      # Conditionally created based on environment parameter
      # ============================================================
      - name: s3-replication-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          metadata:
            name: s3-replication-role
          spec:
            forProvider:
              assumeRolePolicy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": {
                        "Service": "s3.amazonaws.com"
                      },
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider
        patches:
        # Only create for prod environment
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/skip]
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                match: '^dev$'
                replacement: "true"

      - name: s3-replication-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicy
          spec:
            forProvider:
              roleRef:
                name: s3-replication-role
              policy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
                        "s3:ListBucket"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::*"
                    },
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication",
                        "s3:GetObjectVersionAcl"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::*/*"
                    },
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:ReplicateObject",
                        "s3:ReplicateDelete"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::*/*"
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/skip]
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                match: '^dev$'
                replacement: "true"

      # ============================================================
      # RDS POSTGRESQL INSTANCE
      # ============================================================
      - name: rds-instance
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Instance
          metadata:
            name: rds-postgres
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              engine: postgres
              engineVersion: "15"
              dbName: appdb
              username: postgres
              allocatedStorage: 20
              dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
              skipFinalSnapshot: false
              finalSnapshotIdentifier: snapshot
              backupRetentionPeriod: 7
              deleteProtection: false
              storageEncrypted: true
              multiAz: false
              publiclyAccessible: false
              vpcSecurityGroupIds:
              - sg-default
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                match: '^(.{0,40})'
                replacement: 'db-${1}'
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbInstanceClass
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbInstanceClass
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbAllocatedStorage
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbBackupRetention
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
        # Enable deletion protection for prod
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.deleteProtection
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                match: '^prod$'
                replacement: "true"
        # Multi-AZ for prod
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                match: '^prod$'
                replacement: "true"

      # ============================================================
      # IAM ROLE FOR SERVICE ACCOUNTS
      # ============================================================
      - name: service-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          metadata:
            name: service-role
          spec:
            forProvider:
              # Default trust policy (programmatic access)
              assumeRolePolicy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": {
                        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:root"
                      },
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.serviceAccountName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                match: '^(.+)$'
                replacement: 'role-${1}'

      # ============================================================
      # IAM POLICY: S3 Access (Least Privilege)
      # ============================================================
      - name: service-s3-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicy
          spec:
            forProvider:
              roleRef:
                name: service-role
              policy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetObject",
                        "s3:PutObject",
                        "s3:ListBucket"
                      ],
                      "Resource": [
                        "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME",
                        "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME/*"
                      ]
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                match: 'BUCKET_NAME'
                replacement: '${spec.parameters.bucketName}'

      # ============================================================
      # IAM POLICY: RDS Access (Least Privilege, Prod Only)
      # ============================================================
      - name: service-rds-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicy
          spec:
            forProvider:
              roleRef:
                name: service-role
              policy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "rds-db:connect"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:*:*:db/*"
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider
        patches:
        # Restrict to prod for least privilege
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/skip]
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: Regexp
              regexp:
                match: '^dev$'
                replacement: "true"
```

---

## 3. Provider Configuration

```yaml
---
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-provider
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds
      key: creds
  assumeRoleWithWebIdentity:
    roleArn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/crossplane-irsa
    roleSessionName: crossplane
    webIdentityTokenFile: /var/run/secrets/eks.amazonaws.com/serviceaccount/token
```

---

## 4. Usage Examples

### Dev Environment Claim

```yaml
apiVersion: acme.crossplane.io/v1
kind: VersionedBucketClaim
metadata:
  name: app-assets-dev
  namespace: default
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: acme-app-assets-dev
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
    dbAllocatedStorage: 20
    serviceAccountName: app-service
    enableOIDC: false
  resourceRef:
    name: app-assets-dev
```

### Prod Environment Claim

```yaml
apiVersion: acme.crossplane.io/v1
kind: VersionedBucketClaim
metadata:
  name: app-assets-prod
  namespace: default
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    replicationRegion: us-west-2
    bucketName: acme-app-assets-prod
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
    dbAllocatedStorage: 100
    dbBackupRetention: 14
    serviceAccountName: app-service-prod
    enableOIDC: true
  resourceRef:
    name: app-assets-prod
```

---

## 5. Key Features Implemented

| Requirement | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **S3 Versioning** | `BucketVersioning` resource, status: Enabled (all envs) |
| **S3 Encryption** | `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` with AES-256 (all envs) |
| **S3 No Public Access** | `BucketPublicAccessBlock` with all restrictions enabled |
| **RDS Deletion Protection** | Conditional patch: `deleteProtection: true` for prod |
| **RDS Multi-AZ** | Conditional patch: `multiAz: true` for prod |
| **RDS Encryption** | `storageEncrypted: true` (all envs) |
| **RDS Backup Retention** | Configurable parameter, minimum 7 days |
| **RDS Not Publicly Accessible** | `publiclyAccessible: false` hardcoded |
| **IAM Least Privilege** | Scoped S3/RDS policies; RDS policy for prod only |
| **Environment Isolation** | Parameters drive resource config; separate claims per env |
| **Cross-Region Replication** | Conditional IAM role/policy for prod environment |

---

## 6. Deployment

```bash
# Apply XRD
kubectl apply -f xrd-versionedbucket.yaml

# Apply Composition
kubectl apply -f composition-versionedbucket.yaml

# Apply provider config
kubectl apply -f provider-config.yaml

# Create dev claim
kubectl apply -f claim-dev.yaml

# Create prod claim
kubectl apply -f claim-prod.yaml

# Monitor resource creation
kubectl get composite
kubectl get managed -o wide
kubectl describe versionedbucket app-assets-dev
```

---

## Notes

- **Conditionals**: Uses Crossplane transform regex to skip/enable resources by environment.
- **Secrets**: DB password must be injected via `ExternalSecret` or stored in AWS Secrets Manager; referenced via `passwordSecretRef`.
- **OIDC**: OIDC trust policy for prod can be parameterized; shown as annotation-based skip flag for dev.
- **Scalability**: Add environment-specific `ProviderConfig` instances per region for multi-region deployments.
